newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Brazil seen becoming top world coffee consumer.
newsitem.headline: Brazil seen becoming top world coffee consumer.

text.p: Brazilians are drinking more coffee every day and the country, the world's leading coffee producer, should become its top consumer within about 10 years, a leading expert said Thursday.
"The growth in demand is fantastic," said Carlos Melles, a Brazilian congressman representing Minas Gerais, the state responsible for about 50 percent of Brazil's total coffee output.

Melles, a grower himself and former leader of Brazil's top confederation of coffee producers, spoke to reporters on his arrival in this Caribbean port city to address an annual meeting of Colombia's National Association of Coffee Exporters.
He said domestic coffee consumption had risen 1.0 million 60-kg bags last year to a total of 11 million bags and that Brazilians were expected to consume 12 million bags in 1996.

By the year 2000, consumption was seen totalling 15 million bags, he added, saying the country looked certain to surpass the United States and become the world's top coffee consumer within 10 to 12 years.
